build_text_encoder: build a CLIP text encoder with optional pretrained ViT-B/32 weights from the clip library
run_CLIPTEXT_forward: run the CLIPTEXT forward pass to encode a list of caption strings into feature vectors
run_CLIPTEXT_tokenize: run the CLIPTEXT tokenize method to convert text strings into padded token tensors
run_CLIPTEXT_encode_text: run the CLIPTEXT encode_text method to transform tokenized text tensors into feature embeddings
run_CLIPTEXT_build_attention_mask: run the CLIPTEXT build_attention_mask method to create a causal attention mask for the transformer
